headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 29, 2026, the portfolio has achieved an average return of 11.39%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 7.66%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 3.73%, indicating that the portfolio is not only growing in absolute terms but is also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 43.10%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 5.36%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. The relative strength of the portfolio during this period suggests resilience amid potential market uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
